mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 10.0% for two consecutive months, it triggers central bank intervention and fiscal stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 10.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both exceed their 12-month moving averages, it indicates broad-based economic expansion supporting corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery (indicated by rising industrial production), manufacturing output growth supports corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods classified as post-recession recovery (INDPRO > 100 and GDP growth positive), or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 100,000 per month (PAYEMS > 100,000) indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of months when PAYEMS > 100,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 500,000 units per month, it signals housing sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 500.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises and retail sales (RSAFS) fall, it indicates weakening labor market and declining consumer demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE is rising and RSAFS is falling, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), central bank commitment to low rates supports asset prices, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
